name: Office Complex Extraction
description: The runners must extract a key corporate asset from a high-security office complex. Cubicles provide light cover, while the executive office at the back is heavily guarded.
scenario_rules: Office Heist: Triggering alarms will decrease available extraction time. Try to take out guards silently or bypass them. Watch out for corporate security drones.
